messages:
Ravi (CS): Glyph signaled elevated p99 after turning on new feature. Renewal call Friday — they asked for a short "ops checklist" to paste into their infra channel. Can we make a terse runbook (caching, batching, streaming) with one-line impacts?
Ivy (Eng): Yes. My minimalist draft: 
- Set X-Priming: true for warmups -> routes to warm pools, reduces cold tail.
- Tenant cache: TTL=20s, scope=tenant -> repeated prompts p95 down ~30%.
- Client bundling: max 6 reqs / 30ms wait -> lowers QPS. Snippet: client.batchSend({maxBatch:6,maxWaitMs:30})
- Stream tuning: chunk_tokens=64; toggle X-Disable-Streaming if stalled.
- Fallback: X-Model-Fallback: compact-1 -> keep availability.
Maya (Onboarding): Add 3 telemetry checks: warm-pool hit %, prefill latency, per-route p99. Also a 3-q feedback form for post-change check-in.
Ravi (CS): Add two quick troubleshoots: if tail rises after deploy -> bump TTL to 30s and async prefill; if origin errors spike -> token-bucket throttle on prefill and reduce batch size. Keep tone friendly.
ops-bot: Created doc "glyph-cheat-paste-v1" in /shared/cs-assets.
Maya (Onboarding): I'll paste a one-pager and small JS + curl examples, non-prescriptive.
Ravi (CS): I'll run the review with Glyph tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
